transcription.text: Right then, it's another show day. So it is show day for Nick and we've also got Mark
on there today so we've got the lads competing this weekend. So we actually had Mark on stage
yesterday. He was at the Pure Elite World Championships in the pro division and you
come away with two top three finishes, a fourth and a fifth in very competitive line ups which
is good. To be fair with Mark, this was a very last minute decision where this was literally
a five weeks prep and he took off nearly ten kilos in five weeks. So to be fair to him,
fair play to him because he's put in some serious work to get where he needs to be.
Then we've got Nick. Nick is a first timer today. He is going to box off his first ever
show and the progress he's made through this prep. I'm going to put an image on the screen
somewhere to show you guys the kind of progress that he's made over this prep. It's pretty
insane and I'm really looking forward to seeing how the lads get on today. It's probably going
to be quite a long day because it is a double header today. He's got the PCA first timers
first and then the PCA UK Open in the afternoon which I'm guessing is going to be very busy
because what they've done is they've allocated pro cards to that part of the show. Usually
this show is pretty dead historically over the last couple of years so I think what they've
done is they've added in some pro cards to entice people to come and compete at it. That
is it. Let's go see how we get on. It's going to be a long day, plenty of caffeine and we'll
see how the lads get on when we get there.
